{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/penguins.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Drop rows with missing values in the columns of interest
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping missing values
print(f"Number of rows after dropping missing values: {len(filtered_df)}")

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = filtered_df['flipper_length_mm'].corr(filtered_df['body_mass_g'])

# Print the correlation
print(f"Pearson correlation: {correlation}")"}
